title: Coefficient and site squares for cartesian proper/open interchange
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings. Let
$k:U\hookrightarrow V$, $r:U\to W$, $p:V\to Z$, and $i:W\hookrightarrow Z$, with $pk=ir$,
be a cartesian square of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme], meaning schemes admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], with $r,p$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $k,i$ open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. Use ordinary constant-ring module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $T_T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ on either site, using [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. For a proper map $v$, let $q_v:T Rv_{*,A}\to Rv_{*,B}T$ be the $B$-linear adjoint transpose of $T$ of the $A$-counit, using the canonical pullback/tensor comparison. For an open immersion $a$, let $t_a:T a_{!,A}\xrightarrow{\sim}a_{!,B}T$ be the summandwise tensor comparison. Neither definition assumes $T$ preserves bounded-below complexes.

Let $\Gamma_R^{\rm et}:i_!Rr_{*,R}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{*,R}k_!$ be the specified proper/open map of [lem-amb-unbounded-proper-open-interchange]: it is the open adjunct of the inverse of open-restriction exchange followed by $k^*k_!=1$, with exchange the counit mate of the inverse-image square [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]. For $E\in D^+(U_{\rm et},A)$ such that $E_B\in D^+(U_{\rm et},B)$, the following equality holds in the unbounded $B$-module derived category:
$$Rp_{*,B}(t_k(E))\circ q_p(k_{!,A}E)\circ T_Z(\Gamma_A^{\rm et}(E))
=\Gamma_B^{\rm et}(E_B)\circ i_{!,B}(q_r(E))\circ t_i(Rr_{*,A}E).$$

For each finite commutative ring $R$ let $N_T=\nu_T^*$ be exact site comparison, $e_a:N a_!^{\rm et}\xrightarrow{\sim}a_!^{\rm pro}N$ its canonical open-extension comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison], and $d_v:N Rv_*^{\rm et}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rv_*^{\rm pro}N$ its specified counit mate [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. On etale-origin bounded-below objects define $\Gamma_R^{\rm pro}$ by the same open-adjunction prescription using the site transports of the open-restriction exchange and the open unit. For every $E\in D^+(U_{\rm et},R)$, these specified maps satisfy
$$Rp_{*,R}^{\rm pro}(e_k(E))\circ d_p(k_!^{\rm et}E)\circ N_Z(\Gamma_R^{\rm et}(E))
=\Gamma_R^{\rm pro}(N_UE)\circ i_!^{\rm pro}(d_r(E))\circ e_i(Rr_*^{\rm et}E).$$
Both squares are natural in $E$. No flatness of $B$ over $A$ is assumed.

proof.text: Extract a normalized existence statement from the recorded unbounded proper/open theorem, selecting the same uniquely determined isomorphism through a small theorem interface. Prove equality with the original recorded choice and the exchange normalization. For coefficient compatibility use the fully proved transpose theorem lem-sp-proper-open-coefficient-mate-transposed, whose proof localizes the canonical coefficient cube and pastes its scalar, proper and open mates. Injectivity of the inverse proper Hom equivalence yields the displayed coefficient square. The site comparison and naturality steps remain as recorded below.

source.place: Existence, uniqueness, naturality; the coefficient comparison is the adjoint transpose, and the proper/open map is normalized by its open adjunct

proof.text: For the site equation, first identify the inverse bounded-below restriction comparison with the open-adjunction transpose of the bounded-below proper/open map. Apply the fully faithful inclusion, the canonical inclusion compatibility isomorphisms, and naturality of the unbounded open unit to prove this identification. Use the open counit normalization of [lem-amb-compact-support-site-comparison-open], specialized to the compactification of the open immersion i. Expand the inverse open-adjunction bijections as counit composites. Naturality of the open site-extension comparison moves the inverse restriction map across comparison; cancellation of the proper direct-image comparison and counit naturality identify the two composites. This is the elementary transportOpenAdjunct calculation. Its specialization gives exactly properOpenSiteRestrictionInverse and hence properOpenSiteInterchange. Finally apply the bounded-below inclusion to the resulting equality. The proper comparison is the specified map of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] and the extension comparison is that of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]; neither is redefined by the desired equality.

source.place: Existence, uniqueness, naturality; transport of the adjoint-transpose comparison through the site comparison

proof.text: For coefficient naturality, compose naturality of openScalarExtension from [lem-coef-etale-open-tensor], finiteCoefficientDirectImageMap_naturality from [lem-coef-finite-direct-image], and properOpenCoefficientInterchange from [lem-amb-unbounded-proper-open-interchange]. For site naturality, transport the unbounded proper/open natural isomorphism through the fully faithful bounded-below inclusion, and show its component equals properOpenCoefficientInterchangePlus. Whisker its hom with site comparison, then compose the proper direct-image natural transformation of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] and the open-extension natural isomorphism of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Naturality of this composite gives the stated identity. These naturality proofs do not require the corresponding square equality.

proof_origin.place: Coefficient transpose proved by canonical mate and exact-localization coherence. Proper/open selection abstracted through its determining exchange normalization and proved equal to the original choice. Existing site and naturality proofs preserved.

lean.statement: theorem properOpen_coefficient_mate {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (φ : A →+* B) (sq : IsPullback k r p i) (E : DerivedCategoryModule A U) (_hE : ∃ n : ℤ, E.IsGE n) (_hEB : ∃ n : ℤ, ((scalarExtension φ U).obj E).IsGE n) : (scalarExtension φ Z).map ((properOpenCoefficientInterchange A sq).hom.app E) ≫ finiteCoefficientDirectImageMap φ p (D((k)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj E) ≫ R((p)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} B]).map ((openScalarExtension φ k).hom.app E) = properOpenCoefficientComposite φ sq E
